profiles.name: Urea

nutrient_functions.N: Essential for chlorophyll, amino acids, proteins, enzymes and vegetative growth. Supports leaf development and crop canopy formation.

profiles.description: A concentrated nitrogen fertilizer widely used in Ethiopian crop production. Commercial agricultural urea is commonly supplied as prills or granules.
soil_considerations: Nitrogen availability depends on soil moisture, temperature, placement and management.
Surface-applied urea can lose nitrogen through ammonia volatilization, especially on high-pH soils and when left exposed.
Repeated nitrogen use without balanced nutrient management can contribute to soil acidification.
application_guidance: Use the locally approved crop recommendation and product label.
Split applications may improve nitrogen-use efficiency for suitable crops.
Incorporate or place urea appropriately; avoid leaving it exposed on the soil surface where volatilization risk is high.
Avoid direct contact between concentrated fertilizer and seeds.
compatibility: Do not assume compatibility from appearance. Mixing depends on moisture, storage duration and the other product's chemistry.
Avoid storing mixtures with incompatible products.
deficiency_indicators: Older leaves may become uniformly pale or yellow.
Plants may show weak vegetative growth and reduced tillering.
excess_and_risks: Excess nitrogen can cause lodging, delayed maturity, excessive vegetative growth and nutrient imbalance.
Nitrogen loss can occur through volatilization, leaching and denitrification.
storage: Protect from moisture and direct contact with water.
Store away from incompatible chemicals and food or animal feed.

verification.visual_identity: White prills or granules are not sufficient proof of urea.
verification.grade_verification: Confirm 46% nitrogen from the original label, manufacturer specification or laboratory analysis.

sources: IFDC Ethiopia fertilizer grade reference: Urea 46-0-0

physical_characteristics.visual_identification: Urea-like appearance; grade requires independent confirmation.
physical_characteristics.colour_variation: Commercial products may differ slightly in whiteness due to manufacturing, coatings and storage.
physical_characteristics.particle_consistency: Usually relatively uniform within a product batch.
physical_characteristics.visual_limits: White rounded granules alone cannot prove urea identity or 46% nitrogen content.

identification_method.identification_limit: Urea-like appearance; grade requires independent confirmation.

identity.classification: Synthetic mineral nitrogen fertilizer; straight fertilizer
identity.nitrogen_content: Approximately 46% nitrogen by mass for standard fertilizer-grade urea
identity.nutrient_forms: Amide nitrogen, which is transformed in soil through microbial processes

physical_fingerprint.colour_variation: Commercial products may differ slightly in whiteness due to manufacturing, coatings and storage.
physical_fingerprint.particle_consistency: Usually relatively uniform within a product batch.
physical_fingerprint.texture: Granular, prilled or crystalline; not normally fibrous or soil-like.
physical_fingerprint.visual_limits: White rounded granules alone cannot prove urea identity or 46% nitrogen content.

agronomy.main_function: Supplies nitrogen for chlorophyll, amino acids, proteins, enzymes and vegetative growth.
agronomy.soil_behaviour: Urea hydrolyses to ammonium after application. Surface application under warm conditions can cause ammonia volatilization, especially without suitable incorporation or rainfall.
agronomy.management: Placement, timing, soil moisture and local recommendations affect nitrogen-use efficiency.
risks: excess nitrogen can promote excessive vegetative growth
poor timing can increase nitrogen losses
direct contact with seed or young roots at high concentration can injure plants

identification.best_result: Urea-like visual candidate; confirm product grade from a traceable label or laboratory analysis.

translations.name: ዩሪያ
translations.classification: ማዕድናዊ፣ ሰው ሠራሽ፣ ቀጥተኛ የናይትሮጅን ማዳበሪያ
translations.description: ዩሪያ በክብደት 46% ናይትሮጅን የያዘ ከፍተኛ የናይትሮጅን ማዳበሪያ ነው። በአብዛኛው በነጭ ትንንሽ እህሎች ወይም በጥራጥሬ ቅርጽ ይቀርባል።
translations.agricultural_uses: የናይትሮጅን እጥረትን ለማስተካከል፣ የቅጠልና የግንድ እድገትን ለመደገፍ እና በእድገት ወቅት ናይትሮጅን ለማቅረብ ይጠቅማል።
translations.crop_suitability: ስንዴ፣ በቆሎ፣ ጤፍ፣ ገብስ፣ ማሽላ፣ ሩዝ፣ አትክልቶች፣ ቡናና ናይትሮጅን የሚፈልጉ ሌሎች ሰብሎች።
translations.application_guidance: የአፈር ምርመራን፣ የሰብሉን ፍላጎትና የአካባቢውን የግብርና ምክረ ሐሳብ ይከተሉ። በተገቢው ሁኔታ ወደ አፈር ማስገባት ወይም በዝናብ/መስኖ ማስከተል የናይትሮጅን መጥፋትን ይቀንሳል። ከዘር ጋር በቀጥታ እንዳይነካ ይጠንቀቁ።
translations.soil_considerations: ዩሪያ በአፈር ውስጥ በዩሬዝ ኢንዛይም አማካኝነት ይቀየራል። በአፈር ላይ ተበትኖ ሳይሸፈን ከቆየ፣ በተለይም በሙቀትና በአልካላይን አፈር ሁኔታ፣ ናይትሮጅን በአሞኒያ መልክ ሊጠፋ ይችላል።
translations.nutrient_functions: ናይትሮጅን ለክሎሮፊል፣ ለአሚኖ አሲዶች፣ ለፕሮቲኖችና ለኢንዛይሞች መፍጠር አስፈላጊ ነው። የቅጠልና የግንድ እድገትን እንዲሁም የተክል አረንጓዴ ቀለምን ይደግፋል።
translations.physical_forms: ነጭ ትንንሽ ክብ እህሎች፣ ነጭ ጥራጥሬዎች ወይም ክሪስታላዊ ቅርጽ።
translations.compatibility: ከሌሎች ማዳበሪያዎች ጋር የመቀላቀል ተስማሚነት በእርጥበት፣ በማከማቻ ጊዜና በኬሚካላዊ ባህሪ ይወሰናል። ተስማሚነት ሳይረጋገጥ አትቀላቅሉ።
translations.deficiency_indicators: የናይትሮጅን እጥረት ሲኖር የቆዩ የታችኛው ቅጠሎች ወደ ቢጫ ሊለወጡ ይችላሉ። እድገትና የቅጠል መፍጠር ሊዳከሙ ይችላሉ።
translations.excess_and_risks: ከመጠን በላይ ናይትሮጅን የተክል መውደቅን፣ የመብሰል መዘግየትን፣ ከመጠን በላይ የቅጠል እድገትንና የንጥረ ነገር ሚዛን መዛባትን ሊያመጣ ይችላል።
translations.storage: በደረቅና በተዘጋ ቦታ ያስቀምጡ። ከውሃና ከእርጥበት ይጠብቁ፤ ከምግብ፣ ከእንስሳት መኖና ከማይስማሙ ኬሚካሎች ለይተው ያከማቹ።
translations.manufacturing_process: ዩሪያ በኢንዱስትሪ ደረጃ አሞኒያ (NH₃) ከካርቦን ዳይኦክሳይድ (CO₂) ጋር በማዋሃድ ይመረታል። መጀመሪያ አሞኒየም ካርባሜት ይፈጠራል፤ ከዚያ ውሃ በማስወገድ ዩሪያ ይገኛል።
translations.solubility: ዩሪያ በውሃ ውስጥ በጣም በቀላሉ ይሟሟል። የመሟሟትና በአፈር ውስጥ የመንቀሳቀስ ሁኔታው በሙቀት፣ በውሃና በአፈር ሁኔታ ይለያያል።
translations.nitrogen_transformations: ዩሪያ የአሚድ ናይትሮጅን ይዟል። በአፈር ውስጥ ያለው ዩሬዝ ኢንዛይም ዩሪያን ወደ አሞኒያና ካርቦን ዳይኦክሳይድ ይቀይረዋል። አሞኒያው በእርጥብ አፈር ውስጥ ወደ አሞኒየም ሊለወጥ ይችላል። አሞኒየም በተክል ሊወሰድ ወይም በናይትሪፊኬሽን ወደ ናይትሬት ሊቀየር ይችላል። ናይትሬት በውሃ ሊታጠብ ይችላል።
translations.quality_reference: የFAO የማጣቀሻ ዝርዝር፦ በደረቅ ክብደት መሠረት ቢያንስ 46% ናይትሮጅን፣ ከፍተኛው 1% እርጥበትና ከፍተኛው 1.5% ባዮሬት። ይህ ለሁሉም ገበያዎች የሚሠራ ሕጋዊ ደረጃ አይደለም፤ የምርቱን የተፈቀደ መስፈርት ያረጋግጡ።
translations.sensor_diagnosis_guidance: ሴንሰሩ የሚለካቸውን አካላዊ ባህሪያት ብቻ ይመዝግቡ። እነዚህ ንባቦች ከዩሪያ መገለጫ ጋር ለማነጻጸር ሊረዱ ይችላሉ፤ ግን በቀለምና በቅንጣት ቅርጽ ብቻ የኬሚካል ማንነትን፣ 46% የናይትሮጅን ይዘትን፣ ንጽህናን ወይም የባዮሬት መጠንን ማረጋገጥ አይቻልም።
translations.physical_characteristics: ቀለሙ ብዙውን ጊዜ ነጭ፣ ነጭ ወደ ክሬም የሚያደላ ነው። በትንንሽ ክብ እህሎች፣ በጥራጥሬ ወይም በክሪስታላዊ ቅርጽ ይገኛል። ገጽታው ለስላሳ ወይም ትንሽ ሻካራ ሊሆን ይችላል። የእህሎቹ መጠን በአንድ ምርት ውስጥ ብዙውን ጊዜ ተመሳሳይ ነው። ጨው፣ ስኳርና ሌሎች ነጭ ማዳበሪያዎች ተመሳሳይ ሊመስሉ ይችላሉ። በዓይን ብቻ ዩሪያን በእርግጠኝነት መለየት አይቻልም።

top.focus_en: Top-layer inspection: exposed surface, visible particle condition, surface distribution and exposure to air or moisture.
top.focus_am: የላይኛው ክፍል ምርመራ፦ የውጭ ገጽታ፣ የቅንጣት ሁኔታ፣ የተበተነበት ሁኔታና ለአየር ወይም ለእርጥበት መጋለጥ።
top.observation_en: The top position is recorded as the surface inspection point. Review visible colour, particle form, surface crusting and signs of moisture.
top.observation_am: ይህ የላይኛው የምርመራ ቦታ ነው። የሚታየውን ቀለም፣ የቅንጣት ቅርጽ፣ የገጽታ መጠንጠንና የእርጥበት ምልክቶች ይመልከቱ።
top.recommended_check_en: Compare the surface material with the product's known physical description and inspect for contamination or weather exposure.
top.recommended_check_am: የገጽታውን ቁሳቁስ ከምርቱ የታወቀ አካላዊ መግለጫ ጋር ያነጻጽሩ፤ ብክለትና ለአየር ሁኔታ መጋለጥን ይመርምሩ።
top.sampling_note_en: Take a representative surface sample without mixing it with material from other positions.
top.sampling_note_am: ከላይኛው ክፍል ብቻ የሚወክል ናሙና ይውሰዱ፤ ከሌሎች ክፍሎች ጋር አይቀላቅሉት።

middle.focus_en: Middle-layer inspection: internal bulk appearance, particle-size consistency, mixture uniformity and representative material condition.
middle.focus_am: የመካከለኛው ክፍል ምርመራ፦ የውስጥ ቁሳቁስ ገጽታ፣ የቅንጣት መጠን ተመሳሳይነት፣ የቅልቅሉ አንድነትና የተወካይ ናሙና ሁኔታ።
middle.observation_en: The middle position is recorded as the central inspection point. Review whether particles and components appear evenly distributed.
middle.observation_am: ይህ የመካከለኛው የምርመራ ቦታ ነው። ቅንጣቶችና ክፍሎች በእኩል ሁኔታ መበተናቸውን ይመልከቱ።
middle.recommended_check_en: Compare the central material with the top and bottom samples to identify visible variation or mixing differences.
middle.recommended_check_am: የመካከለኛውን ቁሳቁስ ከላይኛውና ከታችኛው ናሙና ጋር በማነጻጸር የሚታይ ልዩነት ይፈልጉ።
middle.sampling_note_en: Collect a representative sample from the middle layer while keeping it separate from the other positions.
middle.sampling_note_am: ከመካከለኛው ክፍል የሚወክል ናሙና ይውሰዱ፤ ከሌሎች ክፍሎች ለይተው ያቆዩት።

bottom.focus_en: Bottom-layer inspection: settling, compaction, fine-particle accumulation, moisture concentration and possible segregation.
bottom.focus_am: የታችኛው ክፍል ምርመራ፦ መርገት፣ መጠቅጠቅ፣ ጥቃቅን ቅንጣቶች መከማቸት፣ የእርጥበት ማተኮርና የቁሳቁስ መለያየት።
bottom.observation_en: The bottom position is recorded as the lower-layer inspection point. Review the material for settled fines, compacted masses and moisture-related changes.
bottom.observation_am: ይህ የታችኛው ክፍል የምርመራ ቦታ ነው። የተከማቹ ጥቃቅን ቅንጣቶችን፣ የተጠቀጠቁ ክፍሎችንና ከእርጥበት ጋር የተያያዙ ለውጦችን ይመልከቱ።
bottom.recommended_check_en: Compare the lower material with the upper layers and check whether storage or handling has caused visible separation.

profiles.manufacturing_process: Industrial urea is manufactured by reacting ammonia (NH3) with carbon dioxide (CO2) to form ammonium carbamate, which is dehydrated to produce urea. The product is then concentrated and formed into prills or granules.
profiles.solubility: Urea is highly water-soluble. Its dissolution allows it to move with soil water. Solubility and movement depend on temperature, water availability and soil conditions.
nitrogen_transformations: Urea contains nitrogen in amide form.
Soil urease enzymes hydrolyse urea, producing ammonia and carbon dioxide; ammonia can form ammonium in moist soil.
Ammonium can be absorbed by plants or converted by nitrifying microorganisms into nitrate.
Nitrate can be absorbed by plants but is also susceptible to leaching.
Ammonia volatilization risk increases when urea remains on the soil surface, especially under warm conditions and high soil pH.

quality_reference.basis: FAO reference fertilizer specification; not a universal legal specification for every market.
quality_reference.verification: Confirm the applicable product standard and manufacturer's guaranteed analysis.

sensor_diagnosis_guidance.observable: A sensor may record physical or material properties only when its actual sensing elements support those measurements.
sensor_diagnosis_guidance.inference: Physical readings can support comparison with a known urea profile, but should be reported as a candidate match rather than chemical confirmation.
sensor_diagnosis_guidance.not_confirmable_from_appearance: Exact nitrogen percentage, biuret concentration, molecular identity, purity and fertilizer grade cannot be established from colour or particle shape alone.
sensor_diagnosis_guidance.confirmation: Chemical identity and nutrient grade require suitable chemical sensing or laboratory analysis.

profiles.name: Diammonium Phosphate (DAP)

nutrient_functions.N: Supports chlorophyll, protein formation and early vegetative growth.
nutrient_functions.P: Supports root development, energy transfer through ATP, early crop establishment, flowering and seed development.

profiles.description: A concentrated nitrogen-phosphorus fertilizer historically important in Ethiopia. The grade expresses 18% nitrogen and 46% phosphate as P2O5, not 46% elemental phosphorus.
physical_forms: grey, tan or other manufacturer-dependent granule colours
soil_considerations: Phosphorus can become less available in strongly acidic soils through reactions with iron and aluminium.
In calcareous or high-pH soils, phosphorus can react with calcium.
Soil testing helps determine phosphorus availability and application strategy.
application_guidance: Use a crop- and location-specific recommendation.
Place phosphorus appropriately near the developing root zone while avoiding direct seed contact with concentrated fertilizer.
Do not assume DAP alone supplies all nutrients required by a crop.
compatibility: Compatibility depends on the chemical form and moisture content of the other fertilizer.
Do not mix and store products without verified compatibility guidance.
deficiency_indicators: dark green or sometimes purplish foliage in susceptible crops
excess_and_risks: Excess phosphorus can contribute to nutrient imbalance and environmental phosphorus loss.
High phosphorus availability can reduce zinc uptake in some conditions.

verification.visual_identity: Granule colour and shape cannot reliably distinguish DAP from other fertilizers.
verification.grade_verification: Verify 18-46-0 from the label or a laboratory analysis.

sources: IFDC Ethiopia fertilizer grade reference: DAP 18-46-0

physical_characteristics.visual_identification: DAP-like appearance; cannot be distinguished reliably from all compound fertilizers by appearance alone.
physical_characteristics.colour_variation: Colour can vary by manufacturer, raw materials, granulation and product handling.
physical_characteristics.particle_consistency: Often moderately uniform, but colour and particle size can vary.
physical_characteristics.visual_limits: Appearance cannot reliably distinguish DAP from NPS or other compound fertilizers.

identification_method.identification_limit: DAP-like appearance; cannot be distinguished reliably from all compound fertilizers by appearance alone.

identity.classification: Mineral inorganic compound fertilizer; NP fertilizer
identity.nutrient_content: Standard 18-46-0 grade indicates 18% N and 46% P2O5 equivalent.

physical_fingerprint.colour_variation: Colour can vary by manufacturer, raw materials, granulation and product handling.
physical_fingerprint.particle_consistency: Often moderately uniform, but colour and particle size can vary.
physical_fingerprint.visual_limits: Appearance cannot reliably distinguish DAP from NPS or other compound fertilizers.

agronomy.main_function: Supplies nitrogen and phosphorus, especially useful for early crop establishment where phosphorus is required.
plant_effects: phosphorus supports energy transfer and early establishment
agronomy.soil_behaviour: Phosphate can become less available through reactions with iron and aluminium in acidic soils or calcium in alkaline and calcareous soils.
agronomy.management: Placement near the root zone, without direct seed contact at damaging concentrations, can improve phosphorus access. Use soil-test and local recommendations.
risks: excess phosphorus can contribute to nutrient imbalance
excess localized fertilizer concentration can injure seedlings
ammonia-related injury may occur when placed close to sensitive seed or roots under certain conditions

strong_visual_evidence: grey, tan or brown granular particles
identification.best_result: DAP-like mineral compound candidate; exact identity requires product verification.

middle.focus_en: Middle-layer inspection: internal bulk appearance, particle-size consistency, mixture uniformity and representative material condition.

translations.composition_analysis: የተጠቀሰው ጥሬ እቃ 100% ንጹህ የተፈጥሮ ኦርጋኒክ ባዮማስ ነው። የተለዩት ግብዓቶች የዋርካ ቅጠሎች፣ የበሳና ቅጠሎች፣ የሙዝ ልጣጭ፣ የእንጨት አመድ እና የግብርና ኖራ ናቸው።
translations.chemical_and_toxicity_results: የሰው ሠራሽ N-P-K ኬሚካሎች አልተገኙም (0.00%)። ከባድ ብረቶችና መርዛማ ቅሪቶች ከመለያ ገደቡ በታች ናቸው (SAFE)። የኬሚካል ንጽህና መስፈርቱ 100% ከሰው ሠራሽ ኬሚካሎች ነፃ መሆን ነው።
translations.microbiological_assessment: ጠቃሚ ንቁ ረቂቅ ሕዋሳት ተገኝተዋል። ናይትሮጅንን የሚያያዙ ረቂቅ ሕዋሳት POSITIVE (+) ናቸው። ፎስፌትን የሚያሟሟ ረቂቅ ሕዋሳትም POSITIVE (+) ናቸው።
translations.soil_acidity_management: የአፈር አሲዳማነት (pH) የማስተካከል አቅሙ HIGH ነው። በተፈጥሯዊ ማዕድናዊ ማቋቋሚያ ንጥረ ነገሮች አማካኝነት አሲዳማ አፈርን ያስተካክላል።
translations.analyzer_assessment: የአውቶማቲክ አናላይዘር ውጤት፦ ሃውትሮ 100% ባዮ-ኦርጋኒክ የአፈር ማሻሻያ ነው። የሰው ሠራሽ N-P-K ኬሚካሎች አልተገኙም (0.00%)። ጠቃሚ ረቂቅ ሕዋሳት ተገኝተዋል፤ የናይትሮጅን ማያያዝና የፎስፌት ማሟሟት ምርመራዎች POSITIVE (+) ናቸው። የአፈር አሲዳማነት የማስተካከል አቅሙ HIGH ነው።
translations.laboratory_certification: የላብራቶሪ ትንተናው ይህ ናሙና 100% የተፈጥሮ፣ ከኬሚካሎች ነፃ የሆነ ኦርጋኒክ የማዳበሪያ ፔሌት መሆኑን ያረጋግጣል። የአፈርን ለምነት ሊያሻሽሉ እና የአፈር አሲዳማነትን በተፈጥሮ ሊያስተካክሉ የሚችሉ ንቁ ጠቃሚ ረቂቅ ሕዋሳትን ይዟል፤ ምንም ዓይነት ሰው ሠራሽ ኬሚካል ንጥረ ነገር የለውም።

translations.nutrient_summary: የሰው ሠራሽ N-P-K ኬሚካሎች አልተገኙም (0.00%)። የጠቅላላ N፣ P እና K መጠኖች በሪፖርቱ አልተሰጡም።
